title: Naturality of the normalized derived local class
statement: For a ringed space $Y$ [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image] with a derived category of module sheaves, any integer $q$ and any derived morphism $a:K\to L$, the normalized local-class maps $\Theta$ [lem-weil-pbc-derived-adjunction-top-edge] satisfy $P^q_Y(a);\Theta_L=\Theta_K;\Gamma(-,H^q(a))$ as morphisms of abelian presheaves.

source.place: Tag 01E4, lemma-describe-higher-direct-images; Tag 01FB, remark-explain-arrow; Tags 0BKJ and 0D5X; normalization on the fixed K-injective representatives

proof.text: Use the proved sheafificationAt_naturality lemma in UnboundedDirectImageSectionPresheaf through a proof-only import all. This is naturality of the fixed normalization, including its K-injective model and resolution isomorphisms.

Apply the underlying-presheaf functor to that equation, expanding functoriality of composition. Naturality of the sheafification unit moves P(a) past the unit. Substitute the first equation and reassociate. This is exactly naturality of topEdgeLocalClass, whose definition is the unit followed by the normalized sheafification comparison.

lean.statement:
theorem squareLocalClass_naturality (q : ℤ)
    {K L : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y))} (a : K ⟶ L) :
    (localHypercohomologyPresheaf Y q).map a ≫ topEdgeLocalClass Y q L =
      topEdgeLocalClass Y q K ≫
        (localAbelianSections Y).map ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).map a)
